events.continuity_hook: Carry the viable Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning outbound itineraries, airport-to-meeting travel estimate, Wednesday meeting time, Thursday walkthrough window, later nonstop return, airfare totals, and added hotel-night implication into complete trip pricing.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the practical flight schedules against both work commitments and select an itinerary for the hotel search without purchasing.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus needs to reach Richmond for a Wednesday afternoon regional meeting and a Thursday morning restaurant walkthrough. A Wednesday morning nonstop from Chicago arrives with little room for a delay before the meeting, while traveling Tuesday evening adds a hotel night; the available Thursday returns include an early flight that conflicts with the walkthrough and a later nonstop that gets him home near bedtime.

events.continuity_hook: Retain the selected flights, both hotel candidates, complete two-night totals, refund deadlines, airport transfer times, Wednesday meeting route, Thursday walkthrough route, and estimated trip to the airport after the walkthrough.
events.interaction_goal: Compare complete lodging and local transportation costs, verify that each location works for the two appointments, and choose a hotel while leaving the trip unbooked.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus has selected the Tuesday evening nonstop and Thursday evening return, creating a two-night stay. A downtown hotel is walkable to Wednesday's meeting but requires a morning rideshare to the suburban walkthrough, while a less expensive hotel near the walkthrough would require two longer trips on Wednesday; one quoted rate becomes nonrefundable before his internal meeting schedule is finalized.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the final flight itinerary, downtown hotel, two-night room total, airfare total, refund deadline, late-arrival note, Wednesday walking route, Thursday rideshare estimate, and walkthrough-to-airport timing together as the completed work trip.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck the traveler name, dates, current totals, hotel terms, and Thursday airport margin, then book the flights and room if all details remain accurate.
events.scenario_brief: The downtown hotel still has a cancellable room for both nights, and the selected flights remain available at a modestly higher total. Marcus's Wednesday meeting has been confirmed at the original time, and the hotel has verified that late arrival after the Tuesday flight will not affect check-in.

events.continuity_hook: Carry the three-passenger flight totals, Thursday and Friday arrival times, Monday return choices, four-night versus three-night lodging requirement, airport-to-city estimates, and Friday museum timing into the lodging comparison.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the date combinations using total trip cost and usable family time, then choose travel dates for a hotel search without buying tickets.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus, his husband, and their 12-year-old son are considering a four-night Boston trip over a school holiday, with either a Thursday evening or Friday morning departure from Chicago and a Monday return. The Thursday flight preserves all of Friday but adds a hotel night, while the Friday nonstop costs more for three travelers and arrives too late for a timed museum entry they are considering.

events.continuity_hook: Retain both properties, room layouts, three-guest occupancy terms, complete four-night totals, destination fee, breakfast details, refund deadlines, and travel times to the museum, waterfront, airport, and nearest transit stops.
events.interaction_goal: Verify the sleeping arrangements and occupancy, compare full lodging costs and daily travel time, and narrow the choice without reserving a room.
events.scenario_brief: The family has chosen Thursday evening through Monday and is comparing a Back Bay room with two double beds against a Cambridge one-bedroom suite with a king bed and sofa bed. The Back Bay option is closer to two planned activities but has a nightly destination fee, while the suite includes breakfast and more space but requires confirmation that the sofa bed can be prepared for their son and that the rate covers three occupants.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the selected Thursday-through-Monday flights, seating availability for three, Cambridge suite, confirmed sofa-bed setup and occupancy, complete airfare and lodging totals, included breakfast, refund deadline, and airport-to-hotel plan together as the booked family itinerary.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck all three traveler names, flight dates, available seats, suite occupancy, taxes, and hotel terms, then book the flights and hotel if the totals remain correct.
events.scenario_brief: The Cambridge property has confirmed that the sofa bed will be made up for Marcus's son and that the quoted suite rate includes all three guests. The Thursday and Monday nonstops remain available, but only scattered standard seats are currently shown on the outbound; the hotel rate is cancellable until five days before arrival.
